scenario.title: Backup, import and moving a universe
situations: Move local work to hosted or self-hosted.
Restore onto a fresh machine or replace a local universe.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: What exact checklist teaches which external repositories, services and machine-local secrets are outside the universe move?
Can a user reach the export/restore route before deciding to uninstall in each mode?

lessons.title: Choose the mode-specific export route
lessons.when: Before moving or deleting the universe containing strategy and work
lessons.need: Export is a self-contained universe archive. Local, self-host HTTPS and hosted coordinated download have distinct authority paths. Use the active mode; do not obtain a remote DSN as a shortcut.
lessons.surface: Universe settings documentation; uninstall backup choice; universe export help routes by mode.

lessons.title: Import replaces state and changes credential binding
lessons.when: Before restoring an archive into a local destination
lessons.need: Import replaces the active local universe and requires explicit consent. Imported remote credentials are revoked; local owner authority is established. A binding warning supplies the exact recovery before session registration.
lessons.surface: universe import help/refusal/result; FIRST-USER proposes the earlier setup entry.

lessons.title: Discover restore before destructive reinstall
lessons.when: Switching deployment mode or reinstalling over old state
lessons.need: Offer a supported start-from-backup path before the user discards their only work. Distinguish the Yoke universe archive from project repository files, external services and machine-local secrets.
lessons.surface: FIRST-USER item 9 adds backup adoption to setup; current install documentation teaches uninstall/export.
lessons.gap: Full archive content coverage, restore qualification and hosted/self-host UI paths were not inspected here; do not claim external project resources are backed up.
